title: RHCE (EX294)
blurb: The Ansible automation exam, built on RHCSA: control node and inventory, playbook fundamentals, variables, facts and Vault, Jinja2 templates, roles and collections including RHEL system roles, administration tasks as playbooks, parallelism and delegation, and error handling — all judged on idempotency.
interviewIntro: Exam-shaped automation tasks with worked solutions. Read the task, write the playbook yourself, then reveal the solution and compare — especially the verification step. Every solution asks the question the exam asks: is it idempotent, and does a second run report zero changes?
